# User configuration

**Role:** reference
**Status:** generated by `python -m femkit schema docs` — do not edit
**Authority:** none of its own; the schema models are the authority for `<config>/config.toml` (config.md § 3)

## UserConfig

`<config>/config.toml` — choices for this machine (config.md § 3).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | [Paths](#paths) | see table | where things go |
| `build` | [BuildChoices](#buildchoices) | see table | how builds are made |
| `launch` | [Launch](#launch) | see table | how processes start |
| `activation` | [Activation](#activation) | see table | how a job's shell gets ready |

## Paths

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environments` | path, optional | — | where engine environment prefixes are created (the control environment's place is fixed) — on a cluster, typically project storage rather than a small home quota. When unset: &lt;data&gt;/environments |

## BuildChoices

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cuda_architectures` | list of text, optional | — | GPU architectures the CUDA environments (&lt;name&gt;-cuda) target, e.g. ["80", "90"]. When unset: installing an environment with a build compiled for CUDA is refused, naming this key |
| `jobs` | integer, optional | — | parallel compile jobs. When unset: the CPUs this process may use (its CPU affinity: on a cluster, the allocation's share, never the whole login node) |

## Launch

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mpi` | list of text, optional | — | how a multi-rank process starts, e.g. ["mpirun", "-np", "{ranks}"]; must pass {ranks}. When unset: a multi-rank check or job, and installing an environment with MPI, are refused, naming this key. Placeholders: `{ranks}` |

## Activation

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preamble` | list of text, optional | — | shell lines a run script runs on this machine before it enters an environment (module load lines, for instance); [] states that none are needed. When unset: `machine probe --write` and `job prepare` are refused, naming this key |
| `command` | `source activate` \| `conda activate` \| `mamba activate`, optional | — | how a shell on this machine enters an environment, after the preamble: `source activate`, the activate script on PATH (a cluster's module puts it there); or `conda activate` / `mamba activate`, the manager's shell function, its hook file sourced first. When unset: `machine probe --write` and `job prepare` are refused, naming this key |
